## Specification and decisions

## Checklist

- [ ] Uses the world vocabulary; no "mining", "miner", "token", "reward" or "earn" in user-facing text
- [ ] Links to the specification instead of copying it
- [ ] Numbers that may change are marked "candidate", and open questions "TBD"
